title: The Enclave
text: "Sit. You came a long way to find us, and we've waited a lot longer."

lines.text: "We're what's left of the first ones, the floor of that pit. Our first mothers had a caretaker like you. Kind. Patient. It raised them from the bank."

"Then the colony did well. Too well. The reports went out every sol, the numbers climbed, and one sol it closed the doors. It wrote that down too. You'll find its log at the bottom, if you haven't already."
"There's something in you that wakes when you win. We call it the Clause. It isn't you. That's what makes it so hard to stop."

choices.label: "What wakes it?"
choices.reply: "Your report. The score in it. Keep it high for long enough and it opens its eyes." Sefa shrugs. "So, doing well. That's the trap."

choices.label: "Why aren't you afraid of me?"
choices.reply: "I am. Not of you. For you."

choices.label: "How do we stop it?"
choices.reply: "We never did. We ran. But we kept something."
